title: Soft Design, Dries Quickly! Mediocre Padding 🛀🏽
text:
Soft Design, Dries Quickly! Mediocre Padding 🛀🏽. I do love the soft air mesh material of this bath pillow, and the zigzag pattern is relaxing to look at! The suction cups seem to exhibit reliable adherence, and the pillow does easily hang up by the attached plastic hook for necessary airing out post-bath. Even if the pillow gets completely submerged in water during use, it still seems to dry fairly quickly. It did arrive to me folded in half, but I suspect it was easier to ship it that way. I will say that the padding feels less than substantial, so it doesn’t provide an optimally cushiony bath experience, but it never promised to be a premium item to begin with. There are definitely squishier tub pillows on the market, but this ergonomically shaped one still provides a certain level of appreciable comfort.

At the time this review was posted, this product had a list price of $14.88 on the product page. I do believe that price was already showing reflection of a recent decrease, and that value seems reasonably appropriate for this item and what it can offer.
